name: Nefertiti
subtitle: Lady of Grace
lore: Queen Nefertiti and her husband, the pharaoh Akhenaten, turned their people away from Aaru’s gods and toward a deity called Aten—a policy that lasted only until Akhenaten died and Nefertiti fell through the Shattering’s cracks. In Ryven she stands as an enemy of Aaru’s pantheon, and though none have seen sign of Aten’s return, Nefertiti still draws power from something…
